modules.title: 先分清沙箱和审批
modules.text: 沙箱决定命令能访问哪些文件、网络和系统资源；审批策略决定动作何时停下来询问。产品界面常把两者组合成一个权限选项，但批准动作不会自动扩大沙箱，取消询问也不等于没有访问边界。

lessonPractice.title: 关于权限模式，哪种说法正确？

options.label: Plan / read-only 主要用于读取和分析，不修改代码；确认方案后再进入执行阶段
options.feedback: 对。Plan / read-only 用于理解上下文和制定计划，代码修改应在确认方案后，根据需要选择合适的访问范围和审批方式。

options.label: Full access 只决定模型能力，不影响 AI 对文件和网络资源的访问范围
options.feedback: 不对。Full access 会扩大或取消沙箱等访问限制，影响 AI 可以访问的文件和网络资源。

options.label: Ask for approval 表示 AI 永远不能修改代码，只能向用户提问
options.feedback: 不对。Ask for approval 表示执行需要批准的动作前先询问；获得批准后，AI 仍可能在允许范围内修改代码。

en.title: Which statement about permission modes is correct?

options.label: Plan / read-only is mainly for reading and analysis without changing code; after confirming the plan, move to the execution phase
options.feedback: Correct. Plan / read-only is for understanding context and preparing a plan. Code changes should happen after confirmation, with access and approval settings chosen for the task.

options.label: Full access only changes model capability and does not affect the AI's access to files or network resources
options.feedback: Not quite. Full access widens or removes sandbox restrictions, which affects the files and network resources the AI can access.

options.label: Ask for approval means the AI can never change code and may only ask the user questions
options.feedback: Not quite. Ask for approval means the AI asks before actions that need approval. After approval, it may still change code within the permitted scope.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 开始任何代码开发前，请先和我确认需求，并在 Plan 或 read-only 模式下读取必要信息、制定清晰的方案和计划。在我确认方案没有问题之前，不要修改代码或执行其他开发操作。确认后，再根据任务所需的访问范围选择合适的权限设置；每次扩大范围前先说明影响，完成后检查 Diff 并运行测试。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Before any code development, first confirm the requirements with me, read the necessary context in Plan or read-only mode, and prepare a clear approach and plan. Do not change code or perform other development actions until I confirm the plan. After confirmation, choose the permission settings that match the task's access scope; explain the impact before widening the scope, then inspect the Diff and run the tests.

learning.assumes: You know that an AI agent may read files, edit code, or run terminal commands.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish Codex's Ask for approval, Approve for me, Full access, and Custom settings, then choose settings for read-only analysis, routine changes, and wider access.

modules.title: Separate sandboxing from approvals
modules.text: The sandbox determines which files, networks, and system resources commands can access; the approval policy determines when an action pauses to ask. A product may combine both into one permission option, but approving an action does not automatically widen the sandbox, and fewer prompts do not mean there is no access boundary.

distinctions.label: Sandbox
distinctions.text: A {c:sandbox} is a runtime isolation barrier enforced by the operating system or container; a {c:permission-mode} defines user confirmation rules and operational freedom for an AI tool.
